findings.issue: The initial input-form taxonomy separated JSON text from JSON bytes, incorrectly excluding the Pydantic JSON entry for bytes.
findings.correction: Treat JSON text as one semantic representation; string/byte storage stays in the declared call-shape contract. Do not claim invocation compatibility without input bindings.

findings.issue: An IO decoder constructor shared the input-form capability with value-deserializing entries.
findings.correction: Require a separately source-derived decode-value action for decode-input capabilities. Constructor-only routes remain conditional and require a subsequent Deserialize step.
